It is part of a closed-
cycle cooling system that extracts the most outstanding amount of heat energy generated in the 
distillation towers' heat exchangers and the soap plant's vacuum systems.

one_line: The paper applies and validates an ISO-50001-based methodology to quantify energy savings from replacing motors and adding variable speed drives in a cooling-tower pumping system at a soap/glycerin (oleochemical) plant, with the continuous-process units (distillation towers, soap vacuum systems) mentioned only as the heat source.
